references.text: Moses gave the same promise to Israel that every place their foot treads on shall belong to them. Joshua 1:3 is a direct fulfillment of this promise.
God promised to give the Israelites the land from the wilderness to Lebanon, as detailed in Joshua 1:4.
God gave Abraham the promise of all the land he could see, which forms the basis for the promise now being confirmed to Joshua.
The covenant with Abraham concerning the borders of the land, from the River of Egypt to the Euphrates, is the background for the promise given to Joshua.
God showed Moses the land He had promised to Abraham's descendants, but Moses was not allowed to enter. Joshua was to complete this task.
God spoke to Moses at the burning bush and promised to lead the people to a land flowing with milk and honey.
